question: What claim is made about old age and death being destroyed when this practice has been done for one year?
premises: A practice is carried out for one year.
That practice is described as having been practiced.
When so practiced, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this practice has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: Which practice is meant is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
